**Author:** Vuk.Digital (@v4rvl) · posted 2026-08-30 · received 2026-08-30T20:08:36Z

## Summary
Intro tweet for **the skill**: https://github.com/Vuk97/forward-implementation-first

- **Problem:** GPT models (Sol especially) overengineer *process* — hashes, locks, receipts, status files. The agent redoes finished work because a marker went stale, refuses to act because its paperwork is missing, and reports that as progress. Tokens burned, nothing accomplished.
- **Fix:** the skill makes the agent classify every action as **implementation, validation, or bookkeeping — and skip the third**. Redoing work needs a real reason; stale metadata is not one. Tests and benchmarks stay mandatory.
- **Result:** "took the experience of using GPT models from 3 to 8" — ships instead of managing its own paperwork, saves tokens. Generic across workflows; tune with a few quick edits.

## Why it matters
- Names the exact failure mode seen in agent fleets (ours included): re-verifying markers/receipts, treating bookkeeping as progress, stalling on stale state instead of shipping.
